First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the start time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace isn't posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you're new when you arrive.
Check
Look at @girlbikegang_kc the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Girl Bike Gang Monday Ride group ride

A Monday ride in Kansas City, Missouri for women. BikeWalkKC lists it on its Women Bike KC resources page. Time and meeting spot are on the group's Instagram.
